name: IA Creation Kit
description: Uploads a spreadsheet describing site information architecture and drives an AI agent to build content types, fields, and taxonomy.
project_description:
The Information Architecture Creation Kit (IACK) module is designed to simplify and accelerate the process of building the information architecture (IA) for your Drupal website.

 With this module, site administrators and developers can seamlessly define the structure of their site by uploading a pre-defined file that includes comprehensive details about essential site components such as content types, fields, vocabularies & terms.

 Behind the scenes, this module uses the AI module and its features, namely AI Assistants to orchestrate the work.
